findings.claim: The change does the opposite of what the requirement asks. When `suppressSourceGeneration is true`, the new early `return null;` exits object-info collection before any member, key or accessibility validation runs. The analyzer therefore reports no MsgPack003/004/005/012/015 diagnostics at all for types with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true`. The acceptance criterion says the analyzer must still report its MsgPack0xx diagnostics for such types. Ledger L12 only exempts the generation-only rules MsgPack011/016/017, not the contract rules.
